reuse.why: Extends the existing shared ensureAccountNotLinked in accounts/link.ts, which every *-accounts-link handler already calls first.

duplication.why: One check, one message, no per-provider copies.

placement.why: The shared link guard module is the right layer, but the closed rule sits in a function named only for the already-linked rule.

scope.why: Only the guard check and a focused test in the existing link.test.ts.

maintainability.why: Clean and complete for all providers; the guard name no longer describes everything it checks.

one_place.where: ensureAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts, called by all six *-accounts-link handlers in accounts/app.ts
